content_note: Roadmap action 4.5.1 'Pilot a CBDC in Rwanda - Test inclusive CBDC user access methodologies and tools', lead NBR with FSPs, RSwitch, MINICT, MINALOC. Exact publication date not verified.

title: Staten och betalningarna (SOU 2023:16), final report of the Payments Inquiry
issuer: Government Offices of Sweden (parliamentary Payments Inquiry, Ministry of Finance)
content_note: Inquiry assessed 'insufficient social need for the Riksbank to issue an e-krona' but global changes may lead to a different assessment (as summarised on riksbank.se). Government channel; not opened in full.

title: Orchid Blueprint: Infrastructure for safe and innovative use of digital money (with media release 'MAS Lays Foundation for Safe and Innovative Use of Digital Money in Singapore')
content_note: Blueprint sets infrastructure 'required for a digital Singapore dollar'; release: 'three forms of digital money that MAS is promoting are wholesale CBDCs, tokenised bank liabilities, and regulated stablecoins'. Release: https://www.mas.gov.sg/news/media-releases/2023/mas-lays-foundation-for-safe-and-innovative-use-of-digital-money-in-singapore

title: Eswatini CBDC Diagnostic Study: Phase 1 findings
issuer: Central Bank of Eswatini (with Cenfri; Governor's foreword)
content_note: Ranks CBDC use cases (payment efficiency, consumer demand, stability); Governor's foreword; remaining phases paused pending Payment Switch. Authored by Cenfri for CBE.

title: Initial Design Paper for the Digital Lilangeni (for stakeholder comments)
issuer: Central Bank of Eswatini with Giesecke+Devrient
content_note: Stakeholder-consultation draft (dated 25 May 2023, uploaded 2023-06-09) of the initial design paper; same privacy/offline sections as DV07.

title: Annual Integrated Report 2022/23 (CBDC section)
content_note: Reports G+D engagement after diagnostic found retail CBDC strongest opportunity; continued investigation of a Digital Lilangeni as complement to cash.

title: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) web page incl. Retail CBDC section and FAQ
content_note: 'The Bank of Thailand currently has no plans to issue a Retail CBDC for general use'; FAQ lists benefits incl. programmable payment. Page undated (redesigned 2025-26); date before 2026-10-18 unverified.

title: Dijital Türk Lirası Birinci Faz Değerlendirme Raporuna İlişkin Basın Duyurusu (2023-56)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
content_note: Announces Phase 1 Evaluation Report; phase 1 pilot measured user experience and system performance at selected locations. Cover note for registry report.

title: Annual Report 2023 (DTL passages)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
content_note: PoC studies on programmable payments, e-commerce, international, offline payments and hybrid systems; first phase pilot ended H1 2023.

title: Annual Report 2024 (DTL passages)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
content_note: Phase 2 R&D areas include digital identity integration, programmable payments, token-based systems, offline payments, cryptology and impact simulation.

title: Dijital Türk Lirası Projesi Ekosistemine Katılım Çağrısı (Call to Join the DTL Project Ecosystem, call document)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (Payment Systems and Financial Technologies Dept.)
content_note: DTL presented as complement to existing payments; categories: tokenization, programmable payments, self-sovereign identity, interoperability (POS, wallets, GSM), machine-to-machine payments.

title: Dijital Türk Lirası İkinci Faz İlerleme Raporuna İlişkin Basın Duyurusu (2025-59)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
content_note: Phase 2 continues; current status of programmable payments, offline payments and interoperability shared in Phase 2 Progress Report. Cover note for registry report.

title: 金融穩定報告111年5月 專欄4：國際間CBDC發展趨勢及其政策意涵 (FSR May 2022, Box 4)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
why_manual: agent confidence low; link blocked for scripts
content_note: CBDC 'not necessarily optimal for every country'; designs would protect consumer privacy while meeting AML rules; issuance must fit domestic needs, not a race.

title: 楊總裁專題演講「數位轉型的央行貨幣」(Governor Yang speech at FISC annual conference)
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (Governor)
content_note: Phase-2 general-purpose CBDC trial done; DLT could not meet performance, so architecture centralised with some DLT functions; CBC distributes to banks, banks to public; next: survey, communication, law.

title: 新聞稿：發布「央行數位貨幣(CBDC)對外溝通活動總結報告」
issuer: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
content_note: Releases summary of 2025 hearings (9 events, 1,714 participants); concerns incl. policy objectives, legal basis, system architecture, risk/security/privacy. Cover for registry report.

title: Fintech Development Strategy of Ukraine until 2025
content_note: Action plan lists 'Launch of CBDC project' and task '(i) issue e-hryvnia (CBDC)', NBU with Ministry of Digital Transformation, 2020-2021.

title: Strategy of Ukrainian Financial Sector Development until 2025
issuer: National Bank of Ukraine with financial regulators and Ministry of Finance
content_note: States the E-Hryvnia pilot was carried out and 'a concept for the use of the e-hryvnia (CBDC) at the national level has been developed'.

title: Law of Ukraine 'On Payment Services' No. 1591-IX (defines NBU digital money / e-hryvnia)
why_manual: model: verify_first; agent confidence low; link blocked for scripts
content_note: Defines e-hryvnia as electronic form of the national currency issued by the NBU (cited by NBU FAQ/news). Rada site unreachable from here; text not opened.

title: E-hryvnia Q&A (FAQ section)
content_note: Key features: privacy and safety, payments secured by NBU 'while the regulator will not have any personal information'; offline payments; wallet access recovery; programmability; cash will not disappear.

title: Responses to the Discussion Paper on new forms of digital money
content_note: Summarises feedback on whether a CBDC should offer data protection and privacy; Bank 'has not yet made a decision' but strong support to continue.

title: What is the digital pound? (explainer with Q&A)
content_note: Q&A incl. 'Would the Government or the Bank of England be able to control or monitor my digital pounds?' and why holding limits are needed; answers partly in video.

title: Letter from Andrew Bailey to Dame Meg Hillier MP, Chair of the Treasury Committee
issuer: Bank of England (Governor), published by House of Commons Treasury Committee
why_manual: model: verify_first; link blocked for scripts
content_note: 'No decision has been made on whether to proceed beyond the current design phase'; digital pound only after Parliament passes primary legislation; design-phase costs.

title: Digital Pound Lab: Phase 2 update
content_note: Phase 2 (Nov 2025 to Jul 2026) demos: one-time aliases let users 'conduct a transaction in private'; programmability features (locks) for conditional payments. Page last updated 6 Oct 2026.

title: El presidente del BCU expuso en el Instituto Uruguayo de Numismática (news; Labat talk on digital money)
content_note: Labat: a digital currency 'puede servir a Uruguay para apoyar la competencia, eficiencia e innovación en los pagos'; issuance decision requires infrastructure; refers to e-peso pilot.

title: Evolving payment ecosystems and CBDC: An ecological approach (A. Sarmiento)
issuer: BCU staff (Adolfo Sarmiento), published on BCU payment-system oversight page
why_manual: model: verify_first; link blocked for scripts
content_note: Staff paper (author-views disclaimer): e-Peso pilot issuance capped at UYU 20m, 10,000 phone users, wallets limited to UYU 30,000; platform acted as registry of banknote ownership. staff_research.

title: El presidente del BCU reiteró la relevancia de construir un sistema de pagos que opere con celeridad (news; Labat at IMF/WB Annual Meetings)
content_note: Labat: 2017 pilot 'muy exitoso'; 'Todavía no hemos escalado el proyecto, pero... tendremos nuevos avances el año entrante'; priority is a fast payment system, no contradiction with CBDC.
